title: Review of c03's FCH protocell vesicles (SIBW): Supported on fresh seed 13 with a chi=0 twin; to T=2000 the lumens shrink to ~7 px and contrast decays to 5x
summary: Re-ran the claimed world unchanged on seed 13 (T=800, as claimed), its chi=0 twin (world_chi0.py) on the same seed, and the world to T=2000. From white noise seven bilayer rings nucleate by t~32, five keep a lumen for the whole run (two corner rings fuse into a multilamellar onion around t~400). Lumen/outside solute contrast 25-34x from t=80 to t=800 (100% of frames >= 2x); the chi=0 twin forms the same rings and its contrast falls 2.3 -> 1.13. FACTS: the amphiphile is membrane-like (rim/core 2.6, rim/outside 45, 32/37 individuals). In the T=2000 run the lumens shrink steadily (44-88 px at t=200 to 6-7 px from t~1400) and contrast decays to 5.0x, still >= 2x in all frames.

observations.S: rerun/seed13/sheet.png t=0: white noise over the whole domain; rings everywhere by t=32
observations.I: rerun/seed13/sheet.png t=32-800: five isolated vesicles persist the whole run at fixed positions (6 persistent tracks, FACTS.md)
observations.B: rerun/seed13/FACTS.md radial: amphiphile rim/core 2.6, rim/outside 45, 32/37 individuals membrane-like; sheet shows a cyan bilayer ring around a gold lumen
observations.W: contrast.py on rerun/seed13: lumen/outside 25.7-33.6x for t=80-800, 100% of frames >= 2x; rerun_chi0/seed13 (same seed, chi=0): 2.33 -> 1.13, 13% of frames >= 2x (only the first ~t=100)

seeds_run.result: chi=0 twin: contrast gone (1.13 at t=800)
T=2000: still >= 2x (5.0x), lumens shrunk to 6-7 px

controls_run.W: rerun_chi0/seed13 (the claim's world_chi0.py, same seed): 1.13x at t=800; resolution gate rests on the claim's pack_res15 (not re-run)

verdicts.limitation: The lumens are not stationary: in rerun_long/seed13 they shrink from 44-88 px (t=200) to 6-7 px (t>=1400) and the contrast falls from ~30x to 5x by t=2000 (lumen_long.txt), so the vesicles drift toward lumen-poor micelles on a time scale ~2x the claimed run; W holds for the whole T=2000 but its margin is shrinking. Some rings fuse into multilamellar onions that lose their lumen (2/7 on this seed). The solute is passive (osm=0) and nothing divides, moves or eats. I did not re-run the 1.5x resolution control.
